Container.Name: tmt-build-tracker
Container.Overview: Self-hosted build tracker for makers 3D-printing the MakeGood 3D TMT (toddler mobility trainer) chair. Teams ("chapters") plan, print, assemble and hand off builds together: parts and print plates, filament colors, print logs, a 3D color designer, 3MF export for Elegoo Slicer / OrcaSlicer / Bambu Studio, and optional read-only printer status.[br][br]MakeGood's CC0 kit files are bundled and install themselves on first start. The first account you create becomes the site admin.[br][br]REQUIRED before the first start: create the appdata folder and give it to the container user (Unraid terminal): mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/tmt-build-tracker && chown 99:100 /mnt/user/appdata/tmt-build-tracker. Set BETTER_AUTH_SECRET (generate it with: openssl rand -hex 32) and keep a copy of it.[br][br]If the package is still private, run "docker login ghcr.io" in the Unraid terminal with a GitHub token that has read:packages (see the README).
Container.Requires: Create /mnt/user/appdata/tmt-build-tracker and run: chown 99:100 /mnt/user/appdata/tmt-build-tracker. The container runs as user 99:100 (nobody:users) and cannot write to a folder owned by root. Memory: about 250 MB at rest, about 650 MB while an admin converts STEP files, about 500 MB while print geometry is imported.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port of the web interface on your server. The container always listens on 3000 inside; 8420 on the host is only a suggestion, pick any free port.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database (tmt.db), the installed kit pack, 3D models, uploads and photos. About 150 MB after first start. The folder must be owned by 99:100 (chown 99:100 /mnt/user/appdata/tmt-build-tracker).

Config.Name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Signs sign-in sessions and encrypts stored printer access codes. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32 (Unraid terminal). Keep it stable: changing it signs everyone out and makes saved printer access codes unreadable (re-enter them). The container stops with an error if this is empty.

Config.Name: PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: Optional. The one address people use, without a trailing slash, for example https://tmt.example.com. Leave empty to use http://SERVER-IP:PORT directly (the app accepts whichever address a request arrives on). Set it when you serve the app through an https reverse proxy; required for single sign-on (OIDC). When set, any other address (such as the LAN IP) stops accepting sign-in and form posts.

Config.Name: ADMIN_EMAILS
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated email addresses that are site admins (kit admin and 3D model pages), in addition to the first account created on this install. Case-insensitive.

Config.Name: OIDC_ISSUER
Config.Description: Optional single sign-on. Issuer URL of your OpenID Connect provider, for example https://auth.example.com/application/o/tmt/ (Authentik). OIDC_ISSUER, OIDC_CLIENT_ID and OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET must all be set to enable it, and PUBLIC_URL must be set too. Redirect URI to register: PUBLIC_URL/api/auth/callback/oidc

Config.Name: OIDC_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Optional single sign-on. Client ID from your OpenID Connect provider.

Config.Name: OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional single sign-on. Client secret from your OpenID Connect provider.

Config.Name: OIDC_PROVIDER_NAME
Config.Description: Optional. Name on the sign-in button: Sign in with NAME. Empty means SSO.

Config.Name: MAX_3MF_MB
Config.Description: Advanced. Largest 3MF (in MB) the Files tab accepts: your sliced project (G-code for all plates can make it several hundred MB) or a kit profile. Empty means 1024. The image allows request bodies up to 1100 MB, so raising this above 1024 also needs BODY_SIZE_LIMIT raised (and client_max_body_size in your proxy).

Config.Name: TMT_PRINTERS
Config.Description: Advanced. Set to off to switch the background printer status connections off completely. Empty means on (the app only connects to printers you added, read-only).

Config.Name: KITPACK_DOWNLOAD
Config.Description: Advanced. Set to off to never download a kit pack from GitHub (the pack inside the image is used either way). Empty means a missing pack may be downloaded.
